difficulty_reason: Verify p_fg : QCohstack_fg -> (Sch/S)_fppf satisfies conditions (1), (2), (3) of stacks-definition-stack by checking assumptions (1), (2), (3) of stacks-lemma-substack: assumption (1) holds because strongly cartesian morphisms of QCohstack are those inducing f*F -> G iso (lemma-quasi-coherent-strongly-cartesian) and pullback preserves finite type (modules-lemma-pullback-finite-type); assumption (2) holds trivially; assumption (3) needs: F quasi-coherent with f_i*F finite type over an fppf covering implies F finite type - restricting to an affine open reduces to the algebra statement that for R -> S finitely presented faithfully flat and M an R-module, M (x)_R S finitely generated over S implies M finitely generated over R, a consequence of algebra-lemma-descend-properties-modules.
